methodological_policy.exact_gt_definition: Independently defensible physical property identity: exact street + house number (+ city/BC where available).
methodological_policy.unresolved_definition: Street only, neighbourhood only, condominium only, coordinates only, or listing CDN slug without house number = GT_UNRESOLVED.
methodological_policy.independence_rule: Chaves na Mão listing and prediction candidates are NOT independent GT. Only independent broker listings or public/legal documents can serve as evidence.
